pr_title: mgmt: mcumgr: allow for user defined payload
pr_body:
Use a flag in `c:struct:mgmt_handler` to skip the cbor start and end byte, and instead use pure custom user defined payload.

Fixes #61248
pr_comments:
I do not think that this is the right way to do that.
I think that the property of custom payload should be applied to group not a command, in such case all commands within group would obtain the full payload.

> > I do not think that this is the right way to do that. I think that the property of custom payload should be applied to group not a command, in such case all commands within group would obtain the full payload.
> 
> Should we then add an extra parameter `custom_payload` to `mgmt_find_handler`, that will be set the when the correct group is found? Or how would you figure out in `smp_handle_single_payload` if the cbor start- and end byte should be applied?
> 
> Something like this;

That or, to weasel out of stable API change, provide `mgmt_find_handler_grp` that would be returning entire group object pointer and redesign the `smp_handle_single_payload` around it.

Something like that, you can probably drop `handler_found` from the `smp_handle_single_payload` and `smp_handle_single_req` as the `MGMT_ERR_ENOTSUP` is probably returned from all paths where handler_found would be set to false and the `smp_process_request_packet` can use the `rc == MGM_ERR_ENOTSUP` from `smp_handle_single_req`  to set value to local `handler_found` as call paths where the `handler_found` could be left false have return value of `MGMT_ERR_ENOTSUP` (with exception of, currently,  unreachable code in `smp_handle_single_payload`.

issue_context.title: mgmt: mcumgr: improve custom payload types
issue_context.body:
**Is your enhancement proposal related to a problem? Please describe.**

The SMP Protocol allow users to add their own custom groups (user groups) after group 64, using any type of data as payload. Currently the implementation is tightly coupled with cbor and adds a start and end byte in the payload which happens outside of the users scope. The start byte indicates the cbor format used in the payload, and is not changeable from userspace.

As a user, I would like to add custom handlers that uses Protobuf as the payload format, but I would now have to ignore the 2 byte overhead start- and end byte as they are pointless to custom payload format.

**Describe the solution you'd like**

Extend the Major Types to allow users to add their own payload types, currently described in `c:struct:zcbor_major_type_t` and give the user access to set the start byte using the relevant payload type.
comments: There was a previous PR about this before the transition to zcbor, it is worth looking at again. Though errors would still be reported in zcbor format.
Can you point me to that old PR, maybe I can try to make a new PR based on the old one?
Thank you, will have a look :-)

review_comments: This is stable API change, just add new function that will extract handler from given group.

This probably could be replaced with
```
if (!IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_MCUMGR_MGMT_CUSTOM_PAYLOAD) || !group->custom_payload) {
```
to reduce the #ifdefs
